intro.h2: A Portland, ME handyman for the jobs on your list
paragraphs: Grunt Work Handyman LLC is a handyman service in Portland, ME, run by Aric with Austin working alongside him. We build and replace decks, clean chimneys and dryer vents, paint and take on the smaller jobs most contractors pass over. Small jobs and chimney cleaning are two of the topics customers mention in our Google reviews.

Homeowners tell us what matters to them: someone who gives a quote, shows up when scheduled and cleans up after the work is done. One customer called about repairing her deck and ended up with a whole new one that stayed within her budget. Another hired us for a small entry deck, then had us clean her chimney, paint her bulkhead and clear her dryer vent too.

items.name: Decks and entry steps
items.blurb: We repair worn decks or tear them out and build new ones, from a small entry landing to a full replacement. The set of photos here shows a tired painted entry deck with lattice skirting replaced by a new pressure-treated landing with two sets of stairs and fresh railings.

image.alt: Before and after: an old brown entry deck with lattice replaced by a new pressure-treated landing with two stairways and railings

items.name: Chimney cleaning
items.blurb: A clean chimney matters in a Maine winter. Chimney cleaning is one of the jobs our customers mention most. One homeowner says Aric gave him a quote, showed up when scheduled, cleaned the chimney and then cleaned up after the work was completed.

items.name: Dryer vent cleaning
items.blurb: Lint buildup in a dryer vent slows drying and is a fire risk. We clean out the vent line so the dryer can breathe again. One customer added dryer vent cleaning to a list that also included her new deck, her chimney and painting her bulkhead.

items.name: Painting and small jobs
items.blurb: Got a list? We handle the small stuff too, like painting a bulkhead and the other odd jobs that pile up around a house. Customers mention small jobs and cleanliness in our reviews, and one says every job was done very well and in a timely way.

about.text: Grunt Work Handyman LLC is Aric's handyman business in Portland, Maine, and Austin works with him on many jobs. The name says it: we do the work that needs doing, from building an entry deck to cleaning a chimney before heating season. Customers say they will hire us again or recommend us to others. Aric answers reviews himself, and one customer even thanked the crew with coffee. We answer the phone Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 4 PM.
about.owner_role: Named in every captured review as the person hired; replies to reviews as the owner; last name not stated on Google

service_area.text: Grunt Work Handyman LLC works in Portland, ME. If you live in a nearby town and want to know whether we can get to you, give us a call at (207) 310-0007 between 8 AM and 4 PM on a weekday. Tell us your town and what is on your list, whether that is a deck, a chimney, a dryer vent or a handful of small repairs, and we will let you know.

items.q: What kind of jobs do you take?
items.a: We build and replace decks and entry steps, clean chimneys and dryer vents, paint, and take on small jobs around the house. Our Google reviews mention chimney cleaning, small jobs and cleanliness. If you are not sure whether your job is a fit, call and ask.

items.q: Can you fix my deck, or do I need a new one?
items.a: We will look at it and tell you. One homeowner called to get her deck repaired and ended up replacing the whole deck, and she says it stayed within her budget. If a repair will do the job, we will tell you that too.

Yes. Small jobs come up in our Google reviews. One customer had us build a small deck and entryway, then clean her chimney, paint her bulkhead and clean her dryer vent. Put everything on one list and we will work through it.

items.q: Do you give a quote first?
items.a: Yes. One customer says Aric gave him a quote for his chimney cleaning, then showed up when scheduled and cleaned up afterward. To get started, call (207) 310-0007 or email gruntworkhandyman24@gmail.com with a short description and a photo or two of the job.

We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 4 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call during those hours to reach Aric, or send an email any time and we will get back to you on the next weekday.

final_cta.h2: Got a list of jobs waiting?
final_cta.text: Call Aric to talk through your deck, chimney or odd jobs.
